8c363863-5799-5d2c-a4f7-e33311831460.description: SSP1 (Sustainability - Green Road): A world that prioritizes sustainable development, strong environmental protection, low inequality, and efficient use of resources. Economic growth is inclusive and human well-being improves globally. The baseline assumes no additional climate policies beyond existing trends.

c7cb626a-53e0-58b9-8cd2-726826013dbd.title: IPCC Scenario SSP1 19
c7cb626a-53e0-58b9-8cd2-726826013dbd.description: SSP1-1.9: A sustainability-focused world that achieves extremely strong climate mitigation. Global CO₂ emissions fall rapidly, reaching net-zero around mid-century. This pathway is consistent with limiting global warming to about 1.5°C. It requires major shifts in energy, land use, and consumption patterns.

215e0acc-b9d1-5e12-842c-cfb9d021c5bc.title: IPCC Scenario SSP1 26
215e0acc-b9d1-5e12-842c-cfb9d021c5bc.description: SSP1-2.6: A sustainable development pathway combined with strong climate policies. Emissions peak early and decline steadily throughout the century. Warming is likely kept close to 2°C above pre-industrial levels. This scenario assumes high international cooperation.

d936402f-c0f1-5777-96b6-52897fa01130.title: IPCC Scenario SSP1 34
d936402f-c0f1-5777-96b6-52897fa01130.description: SSP1-3.4: Sustainability-oriented development with moderate mitigation efforts. Climate action is present but less ambitious than 2°C-consistent pathways. Global warming reaches intermediate levels. Environmental goals compete with other development priorities.

8d8dd600-afae-5a1a-ac88-fef2fe3c9baf.title: IPCC Scenario SSP1 45
8d8dd600-afae-5a1a-ac88-fef2fe3c9baf.description: SSP1-4.5: A world striving for sustainability socially and economically, but with relatively weak climate mitigation. Emissions decline slowly or stabilize rather than fall sharply. This results in higher long-term warming.

ab42a4a2-d251-5607-b98c-1964a5751b89.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 baseline
ab42a4a2-d251-5607-b98c-1964a5751b89.description: SSP2 (Middle of the Road): A future that broadly follows historical trends. Economic growth, population change, and technological progress evolve unevenly. Institutions improve slowly and inequalities persist. Climate action advances incrementally but not decisively.

8fedd003-0696-5958-84b3-7cfa6bb16247.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 19
8fedd003-0696-5958-84b3-7cfa6bb16247.description: SSP2-1.9: A continuation of current societal trends combined with unexpectedly strong global climate policies. Rapid emissions reductions are achieved despite moderate governance capacity. This pathway is consistent with limiting warming to around 1.5°C.

181a8119-865a-516a-89f8-ca899d7dec83.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 26
181a8119-865a-516a-89f8-ca899d7dec83.description: SSP2-2.6: A middle-of-the-road world that implements strong but achievable climate action. Emissions peak soon and decline gradually. Warming is likely limited to around 2°C. International cooperation is present but imperfect.

02f0fda4-ba9f-5be3-865e-0a0117021f4a.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 34
02f0fda4-ba9f-5be3-865e-0a0117021f4a.description: SSP2-3.4: Current development trends continue with partial climate mitigation. Policies reduce emissions growth but do not eliminate it. Warming reaches intermediate levels. Climate risks increase but remain manageable in some regions.

a55cf0f9-ccbc-5748-8e6e-1d7876b09da0.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 45
a55cf0f9-ccbc-5748-8e6e-1d7876b09da0.description: SSP2-4.5: The most representative scenario of moderate climate action. Some mitigation policies are implemented, but ambition is limited. Emissions stabilize rather than decline strongly. This results in moderate to high global warming.

11ebe6dc-9b9a-5290-9336-2dc0ad2cc8ce.title: IPCC Scenario SSP2 60
11ebe6dc-9b9a-5290-9336-2dc0ad2cc8ce.description: SSP2-6.0: A world following historical trends with weak climate policies. Fossil fuels remain a major energy source. Emissions remain high throughout the century. This pathway leads to significant climate impacts.

010085ba-47f0-5f59-81a6-0bdab6f89639.title: IPCC Scenario SSP3 baseline
010085ba-47f0-5f59-81a6-0bdab6f89639.description: SSP3 (Regional Rivalry - Rocky Road): A fragmented world with strong nationalism and limited international cooperation. Economic growth is slow and population growth is high in vulnerable regions. Institutions are weak and climate action is minimal.

109bdf23-91ec-5317-bf75-bc0f8fbd6e6d.title: IPCC Scenario SSP3 34
109bdf23-91ec-5317-bf75-bc0f8fbd6e6d.description: SSP3-3.4: A geopolitically divided world that still achieves some climate mitigation. Emission reductions occur mainly through regional or local efforts. Global coordination is limited. Climate risks remain high in many regions.

8532b1e3-a035-50ae-8af1-c4f3d9f24083.title: IPCC Scenario SSP3 45
8532b1e3-a035-50ae-8af1-c4f3d9f24083.description: SSP3-4.5: Regional rivalry constrains effective climate action. Energy systems remain carbon-intensive. Adaptation and mitigation capacities are uneven. This leads to substantial warming and high vulnerability.

29635376-1f93-511e-909b-7f58392a881c.title: IPCC Scenario SSP3 60
29635376-1f93-511e-909b-7f58392a881c.description: SSP3-6.0: A highly fragmented world with minimal cooperation on climate change. Emissions continue to rise or stabilize at high levels. Adaptation capacity is low in many regions. Severe climate impacts are widespread.

74a26a67-a89f-5689-ab03-2c88c9df137b.title: IPCC Scenario SSP4 baseline
74a26a67-a89f-5689-ab03-2c88c9df137b.description: SSP4 (Inequality - A Road Divided): A world characterized by strong inequalities within and between countries. Wealthy groups have access to advanced technology and protection. Large vulnerable populations face high exposure to climate risks.

35c73b87-faec-58a9-aa2d-998637478dcb.title: IPCC ScenarioSSP4 26
35c73b87-faec-58a9-aa2d-998637478dcb.description: SSP4-2.6: Climate mitigation is driven by elites and technologically advanced regions. Global warming is limited, but inequality persists. Adaptation capacity varies strongly across populations. Social vulnerability remains high.

c3f6cee1-12a2-53e2-baae-f6d4dd0b1c5d.title: IPCC Scenario SSP4 34
c3f6cee1-12a2-53e2-baae-f6d4dd0b1c5d.description: SSP4-3.4: Uneven mitigation efforts lead to moderate warming. Protected regions cope better with climate change. Poorer regions face disproportionate impacts. Global inequality shapes climate outcomes.

22404f24-6be7-5e69-9f31-d2c190b5bf5f.title: IPCC Scenario SSP4 45
22404f24-6be7-5e69-9f31-d2c190b5bf5f.description: SSP4-4.5: Moderate climate action in a highly unequal world. Emissions decline slowly and unevenly. Climate risks are concentrated among vulnerable populations. Adaptation gaps widen.

34ce28ca-8396-565f-9c9d-9feddbb2433c.title: IPCC Scenario SSP5 baseline
34ce28ca-8396-565f-9c9d-9feddbb2433c.description: SSP5 (Fossil-fuelled Development - Highway): Rapid economic growth driven by energy-intensive lifestyles and fossil fuels. Technological progress is high, but emissions are very large. Environmental concerns are secondary.

f5cc6b21-b173-553e-9944-b768f6db49f3.title: IPCC Scenario SSP5 26
f5cc6b21-b173-553e-9944-b768f6db49f3.description: SSP5-2.6: Continued economic growth with heavy energy use. Strong mitigation relies on advanced technologies rather than reduced consumption. Emissions decline later in the century. Warming is kept close to 2°C.

dc0d6578-0137-5708-b48f-76c720c8879b.title: IPCC Scenario SSP5 34
dc0d6578-0137-5708-b48f-76c720c8879b.description: SSP5-3.4: High-energy development with partial technological mitigation. Emissions remain high for much of the century. Climate impacts increase but are managed technologically. Resource use remains intensive.

0563a957-871d-5527-aabf-dad5f01c774a.title: IPCC Scenario SSP5 45
0563a957-871d-5527-aabf-dad5f01c774a.description: SSP5-4.5: Fossil-fuel-driven growth with moderate climate controls. Emissions peak late and decline slowly. Warming reaches high levels. Adaptation relies heavily on economic capacity.

e8c6dbb3-ad73-5c53-99aa-6e0eb7cf39d8.title: IPCC Scenario SSP5 60
e8c6dbb3-ad73-5c53-99aa-6e0eb7cf39d8.description: SSP5-6.0: Continued reliance on fossil fuels with limited mitigation. Economic growth is rapid but emissions stay very high. Climate change becomes severe. Long-term sustainability is compromised.
